newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daiwa and Citicorp to launch dlr-denominated fund.
newsitem.headline: Daiwa and Citicorp to launch dlr-denominated fund.

text.p: Daiwa Securities Co Ltd and Citicorp will launch a dollar-denominated contract-type investment trust fund in June, officials at Daiwa and Citibank NA Tokyo said on Friday.
The fund will be managed by U.S. and European-based hedge funds and managed-futures funds, the officials said.
The offer to investors will be made through Daiwa's Japanese and overseas branches from June 9 to 23.
Each unit of the fund is worth $1,000 and the maximum amount of the offer is $500 million, the official at Citibank said.
Citicorp Trust NA (California) will act as the trading manager for the fund.
Citibank NA London will issue an irrevocable letter of guarantee (L/C) that guarantees a minimum return of $1,120 per unit at the time of maturity in five years, the Citibank official said.
Cancellation is possible after three years but investors choosing to hold the fund until maturity will receive a stepped-up guarantee, the Citibank official said.
If the value of the fund exceeds $1,170 per unit at the end of three years, the guaranteed minimum return until maturity will be raised to that amount, the official at Daiwa said.
